description: Read a Parquet file: its schema (column names and types, row count, compression), rows sorted or paged, or every row as CSV (Parquet to CSV). Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/parquet-viewer (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The Parquet file (.parquet), base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped. Up to 10 MB once decoded. Snappy, gzip, zstd, Brotli, LZ4 and uncompressed files are read. Send the whole file as it is, up to 10 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/parquet-viewer (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

descending.description: With sortBy: largest or last first.

offset.description: Rows to skip first, for paging. Defaults to 0.

output.description: rows (the default) returns the schema and the rows as JSON arrays beside the column names. csv returns every row as CSV text instead (Parquet to CSV), in the file's order, up to five million characters; nested values are JSON text.

rows.description: How many rows to return, 0 to 500. Defaults to 20; 0 returns only the schema. Ignored when output is csv.

sortBy.description: A top-level column to sort the rows by. NULLs go last. Leave out for the file's order.

name: parquet_viewer
title: Parquet Viewer
